target_customer: Crypto companies and businesses managing on-chain payments and treasury
problem: Businesses operating on blockchains lack spending controls, approvals and compliance in wallets.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for smart account platform (earlier: infrastructure for wallets)
product_category: Crypto smart account and treasury platform

founders.name: John Rising
founders.background_notes: YC page and Decrypt (senior mission manager at SpaceX)

technical_complexity.rationale: ERC-4337 account abstraction bundlers and paymasters were new in 2022 and the standard was not final, per the company's own ERC-4337 launch coverage.

defensibility.rationale: Open source bundler and a crowded set of providers (Biconomy, Etherspot per CB Insights comparison pages) limit lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search results describe these as adjacent account abstraction players; no dated takeover or copying event found.

market_need_then: Pain in 2022 centered on wallet usability, per Stackup's own posts. Spend figures not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with several other Stackup or StackUp companies in search results; no brand press found.

pivots.from: Smart wallet infrastructure provider (ERC-4337, Coinbase and Trust Wallet as clients)
pivots.why: Customer conversations pointed to a bigger problem of how companies operate onchain (company blog, 2024-11-20)

outcome_analysis: Stackup started as a wallet infrastructure provider for ERC-4337 account abstraction with Coinbase and Trust Wallet as clients, then walked away from that business in November 2024 to build a business on-chain operations platform. It raised a 4.2 million dollar seed in June 2025 led by 1kx. The company is still small with four people and the outcome is open.
notes: YC page shows status Inactive, but the directory csv says Active and the website is live with 2025 footer; exit left as none. Bitpush dates the seed 2025-12-07 versus Decrypt 2025-06-20 (CB Insights snippet agrees with June); used June. Pre-seed date not given. No dated competitor source near 2022 found, list empty.
